import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

The canonical file is written and every check passed. Next I'm registering it as an artifact and then submitting the final declaration.

I've published the lead's report as `202611/ctrl_jk_section_hud/ctrl_jk_section_hud.md` and registered it as `research:202611/ctrl_jk_section_hud/ctrl_jk_section_hud.md` (ref `file:explicit:076c38e992c8466626d980ab`). The commit declaration was accepted, and the research repo is committed after this turn ends.

**Opening order:** The file opens with the title, then a short research-query summary, then the infographic `ctrl_jk_section_hud_infographic.png`, then `## Bottom line`. The report had no frontmatter. The lead's byline lists its inputs, so I moved it to the top of the last section, `## Method and sources`.

**Section order:** Bottom line → Is this a good idea → What happens today (with "What the vault says") → Requirement adjustments → Alternatives considered and rejected → Recommended Section Map design → Implementation sketch → Known divergences deferred to phase 2 → Open questions → Where the five reports disagreed → Method and sources.

**Heading changes:** Some headings had to be valid link targets, so I took the brackets and punctuation out of them. The words stayed, except in two cases:
- **"What happens today (verified)":** the section's first sentence already says the facts were verified, so the heading is now just "What happens today".
- **"What the vault says (cld's scan of all 7,043 notes)":** the scan details moved into the section's first line.
- **"Recommended design: the Section Map":** now "Recommended Section Map design".

**Links:** I added 11 links between sections. They all point at headings that exist, and pandoc renders them correctly. The infographic and cld's mockup image both exist beside the report. There are no external URLs, so I had no web links to check. Nothing needed repair and no links were dropped.

**Checks:**
- Every line of the lead's text is in the new file, apart from the renamed headings.
- All table rows (36 lead, 36 published) and the one Mermaid diagram are carried over unchanged, with its caption.
- Nothing was added beyond the research query, the infographic and the in-document links.

**Proposed diagrams:** none were published.
- **Accepted:** none.
- **Omitted:** none. The image agent proposed no diagrams (`status: "none"`), saying all 16 candidates would only repeat existing tables, lists or the Mermaid diagram, or would invent structure the report doesn't support. As a result there is no `.diagrams.md` file and the report has no figure wrappers.

**Untouched:** the lead's `__final.md`, the five researcher drafts, and the image files are unchanged.
